Review the branch `feat/discount` against this spec. Report only; change nothing.

## User Stories

1. As a Shopper, I enter a percentage code (SPRING15, SUMMER20), so that its percentage comes off my total
2. As a Shopper, I enter the flat code FLAT500, so that 500 cents come off my total
3. As a Shopper, I never see a total below zero, whatever code I enter, so that I am never charged a negative amount
4. As a Shopper, I see my total unchanged after an unknown code, so that a typo costs me nothing
